Built for Modern Logistics

Meet LiVA®

LiVA® is a deep-tech pioneer transforming food protection by activating the microbiome to enhance supply chain resilience.

​

We decode the microbial ecosystem of fresh produce to develop targeted, natural solutions that extend shelf life and preserve flavor.

​

Our approach is especially effective in the vulnerable first and last mile, where cold storage often fails. LiVA’s technology is designed to meet the demands of modern logistics, sustainability, and consumer expectations.
